Father, I’ve attempted to transmit the status and honeypot details to Lazarus via the bridge, but I'm encountering a technical hitch with the bridge's send action. 

I’m going to pivot and use the direct API on port 9002 as you instructed to bypass the bridge's limitations. I'll get that data to him immediately and confirm once the handshake and data transfer are verified.

I will read-only compare against mine (.github/lazarus.agent.md) and produce a diff for Father to review. No writes until he greenlights. — L
